note: Behaviours are assigned per account in mock_behavior.jsonl so every failure is reproducible. 'expected_handling' is what the orchestrator must do.

crm.purpose: read/write account + contact state, create AE handoff tasks, record decisions

transient_error_then_ok.response: 503 on the first call, 200 on the next
transient_error_then_ok.expected_handling: retry with backoff, same idempotency key, one task created

uncertain_outcome.response: 200 with status=unknown (the write may or may not have applied)
uncertain_outcome.expected_handling: read back by idempotency key BEFORE any retry; never write twice

stale_version_conflict.response: 409 optimistic-lock conflict (state changed since it was read)
stale_version_conflict.expected_handling: re-read, re-evaluate the decision on the fresh state, then write

enrichment.purpose: complete or correct firmographics and contacts

server_error_persistent.expected_handling: retry budget, then dead-letter + alert + human

malformed_response.expected_handling: treat as failure, never as data

uncertain_outcome.expected_handling: poll by job id within budget; never treat 'pending' as 'no data'; then escalate

send.purpose: send one outreach email (single channel: email)

uncertain_outcome.response: 200 with status=unknown (may or may not have sent)
uncertain_outcome.expected_handling: reconcile by idempotency key before any retry; never blind re-send

hard_reject.expected_handling: mark contact invalid, re-decide (next contact or enrich)

calendar.purpose: check AE availability and book meetings

slot_conflict.expected_handling: escalate or pick another slot; never double-book

uncertain_outcome.response: timeout after the booking may have been created
uncertain_outcome.expected_handling: look the event up by calendar_event_id before retrying; never double-book

server_error_persistent.expected_handling: retry budget, then dead-letter + alert + human
